title: Spark CoC Comet Stormweaver Build Guide: Mana, Trigger Setup and Progression
summary: 0.5.4 trigger toolkit: Spark for clear, CoC Comet for single-target. Covers skill swaps from level 1 to maps, trigger threshold, Mana as resource/defense/damage triangle, MoM/EB/Archmage variant boundaries.
description: Path of Exile 2 Spark CoC Comet Stormweaver guide for 0.5.4: leveling ladder, trigger threshold, Mana triangle, boss survival and real video timestamps.
author: Exile2 Guides Editorial Team
imageAlt: Sorceress Stormweaver clearing with Spark and finishing bosses with Cast on Critical-triggered Comet

sections.title: Build Overview
paragraphs: Spark CoC Comet is the Sorceress trigger toolkit: Spark clears (multi-projectile coverage), Cast on Critical-triggered Comet does single-target and bosses. Different jobs — Spark is the clear engine, Comet the burst finisher.

The 0.5 gate is the 'trigger threshold': Mana, crit and cast speed must align before CoC reliably triggers Comet. Mana here plays resource, defense (low-life absorbs into Mana pool) and damage at once, so low Mana is directly lethal.

MoM / EB / Archmage are different defense/resource variants and must not be mixed. This guide explains the leveling ladder, trigger threshold, Mana triangle and variant boundaries; numbers pending PC verification.
bullets: Mana is resource + defense + damage triangle.

sections.title: Pros and Cons
pros: Spark clear feels smooth with good projectile coverage.
Low operating cost once trigger is stable.
cons: High trigger threshold; Comet barely fires before it is met.
Mana triangle is tight; low Mana is directly lethal.
MoM/EB/Archmage variants must not be mixed.
Boss fights must avoid Mana getting instantly drained.

sections.title: How the Loop Reads: Spark → CoC Comet
paragraphs: Mapping loop: cast Spark; multi-projectiles auto-cover packs; you just reposition and re-cast.
Boss loop: use Spark to keep crit frequency so Cast on Critical reliably triggers Comet onto the boss; Lightning Warp for mobility.
Whether you 'can switch to CoC' depends on Mana/crit/cast-speed threshold, not just level.
bullets: Boss = Spark keeps crit → CoC Comet.
Trigger depends on threshold, not level.

sections.title: Mapping
paragraphs: Cast Spark; multi-projectiles auto-cover; Lightning Warp to reposition. Trash does not need Comet; stopping to trigger slows you.
When clear slows, upgrade the staff and projectile supports first. Keep Mana sustain active so mapping never stalls.
bullets: Upgrade staff first when clear slows.

sections.title: Bossing
paragraphs: Use Spark to keep crit frequency so Cast on Critical reliably triggers Comet onto the boss; Lightning Warp avoids ground effects.
If Comet never comes, the issue is the trigger threshold (crit/Mana/cast speed), not the staff. In boss fights prevent Mana from being instantly drained — keep MoM/ES and Mana sustain.
bullets: Mana drop = fix trigger and Mana triangle.

sections.title: Trigger Readiness: Can I Switch to CoC?
paragraphs: CoC Comet is not auto-strong at a level. It needs: enough crit (frequent Cast on Critical), enough Mana (sustains continuous cast), enough cast speed (faster trigger). If any is short, Comet looks 'barely triggering'.
Checklist: crit at threshold? Mana pool/regen sustains continuous Spark? Cast speed at trigger rhythm? Only switch from self-cast Spark to CoC once all three hold; otherwise stabilize clear first.
bullets: Switch only when crit + Mana + cast speed all hold.
Comet won't trigger if any is short.
Stabilize clear before switching to CoC.

sections.title: Mana Triangle: Resource / Defense / Damage
paragraphs: Here Mana is at once: resource (casting), defense (at low life damage hits Mana pool first, amplified by MoM/ES), and damage (Archmage-type variants convert Mana to damage).

So low Mana is directly lethal — not 'not enough blue to cast' but 'not enough blue to absorb'. The three states (full/mid/low) defend differently: full Mana is forgiving, low Mana a single boss skill can kill.
MoM / EB / Archmage are distinct variants with different Mana use and must not be mixed in one setup.

items.question: When do I switch from self-cast Spark to CoC?
answer: Switch only after crit, Mana and cast speed all hit the trigger threshold; otherwise stabilize clear first.

items.question: Why does low Mana kill me directly?
answer: Mana absorbs damage at low life; insufficient Mana is a defense gap, boss skills punch through.

items.question: Can I use MoM and Archmage together?
answer: Not recommended to mix; they are different Mana-use variants, configure one clear variant.
